acquisition method: the 20 most intense peptides were isolated and fragmented
cleavage agent: samples were precipitated with trichloroacetic acid and digested with Lys-C and trypsin.
fragmentation method: the 20 most intense peptides were isolated and fragmented by higher-energy collisional dissociation.
instrument: subsequently sprayed into a QExactive HF mass spectrometer
ionization type: QExactive HF mass spectrometer equipped with a nanoFlex ion source.
labeling: proteins were labeled with a tandem mass tag (1 µL reagent per sample)
